title: Microsoft Exchange IsUNCPath Improper Input Validation NTLM Relay Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to relay NTLM credentials on affected installations of Microsoft Exchange. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the IsUNCPath method. The issue results from the lack of proper input validation. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to relay NTLM credentials in the context of SYSTEM.
